goal: Preserve 24 logical tracks regardless of browser technical-source choice.

provenance_gate.rationale: The contract does not require creating derivatives. Four tracks have unresolved original Pixabay URLs and eight are only probable matches; any implementation that creates a derivative for insufficiently evidenced tracks must STOP for provenance before doing so.

cases.target: Future candidate exposes 24 logical tracks for probe '', maybe, probably.
All 24 originals keep exact baseline Git blob SHA-1; no original replacement is allowed.
Source and dist contain all 24 originals byte-identically.
Opening/initializing music never starts audio.
Opening panel does not instantiate/start playback.
Play/pause/stop-or-approved-equivalent/Escape/keyboard/focus remain operable and accessible.
Panel/catalog usable at 320,390,768,1440 CSS px.
Accessible names and live/error semantics pass; manual screen-reader check required.
Failure of one technical source never deletes the logical track from catalog.
Probe scenarios '', maybe, probably are tested explicitly.
Probe '' still exposes 24 logical tracks.
Probe maybe/probably exposes the same 24 logical tracks.
Build does not silently transcode/replace originals.
Exact codec/profile per original is measured or literal UNKNOWN; extension is not treated as codec proof.
Each track records Pixabay provenance URL/evidence when known and explicit unresolved status otherwise.
Evidence/license status is recorded descriptively; no legal conclusion is inferred.
Any future derivative/fallback has hash, source relation and provenance evidence. Freeze itself authorizes no derivative.
Text equivalent/transcript exists when audio function conveys significant information requiring it.
Local playback requests 0 third-party audio resources.
All original files remain preserved.
